name: Modern SEO - M2L3 Citations and Trust Signals that Work
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-22

Part of: [Modern SEO - Module 2 Three-Step Method](lib:brain-modern-seo-module-2-three-step-method) | [Modern SEO Course](lib:brain-modern-seo-course) | [Learning Index](lib:brain-learning-index)

# Summary
Step 3 of the three-step method (about 6 minutes of speech). Get verified citations on platforms Google trusts: "This isn't about submitting to random directories as if it were 2017." The instructor uses LeadSnap but says any tool is fine. LeadSnap is also used to keep the GBP active.

# Key concepts
- **Connect and activate** the GBP in LeadSnap (Manage Locations, using the Google account with manager access).
- **Manage the GBP from the tool** where possible; categories must still be changed in the GBP itself.
- **Photos:** client photos, geotagged, dripped one per week. **Posts:** own or AI-written, scheduled weekly.
- **Citation business details:** "Sync values from GBP profile," then fill email, keywords, short description, social links, payment options (from the M2L1 questionnaire). Every field filled in both the GBP and the tool.
- **Subscription ($20 per month per location, as stated)** only after client approval and after GBP changes are made.
- **Status meanings:**
  - Live: platform has a two-way API and confirmed back.
  - Submitted: data sent, no two-way API; will always stay Submitted and is usually fine.
  - Updating: data keeps being sent; almost never shows Live.
  - Action required: usually an active citation with nothing to do; click through to check.

# Checklist
- GBP connected and activated; approved changes made.
- Photos and weekly posts scheduled; services added.
- Business details synced and every field filled.
- Client permission before turning on the subscription.
- Statuses reviewed later; "Action required" items clicked through.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Decide the tool with Kim first. LeadSnap is paid and needs her approval; M1L5 says citations can be done manually for free. Present both options for [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub), [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub) and [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Use the field list as a NAP and details check against each [Google Business Profile](lib:brain-google-business-profile), whatever tool is used.
- Summit AZ citations must carry the real number (480) 447-7008, not a DNI pool number.
- Weekly photo and post rhythm per client; photos follow TAG's rule (internal pipe damage or lining work only, never under-sink plumbing). For Pipeliners posts, confirm with Kim whether Scott's blog wording rules apply.
- Read citation dashboards calmly; click through before assuming something is broken.

# Caveats and open questions
- "51 platforms" (intro) vs 47 listings on the example dashboard; counts on screen do not add up.
- "Without manual verification" and platform trust value are instructor claims. The $20 price may have changed.
- The super citation vs regular directory difference is actually explained in M1L5, not here.
